about: Follow-up: the tax bill that rose while the rate fell, as the hook; then every subject on the site is short pages like it, with /reports as the door.

text: The tax rate went down. The average tax bill went up.

Over ten years, the average single-family tax bill in Lunenburg rose {tax.finding.figures.b.text}, while the tax rate fell {tax.finding.figures.r.text}. The bill went up because the average home's assessed value went from {tax.facts[4].value.text} to {tax.facts[1].value.text}.
That's one short page, and the whole site works that way now 📚
